sloka: या पुरा कलहंसानाम् स्वरेण कल भाषिणी ।बुध्यते चारु सर्वांगी सा अद्य मे रमते कथम् ॥४-३०-९॥
transliteration: yā purā kalahaṁsānām svareṇa kala bhāṣiṇī ।budhyate cāru sarvāṁgī sā adya me ramate katham ॥4-30-9॥

translations.english: 'How will my Sita with her charming limbs and sweet words, who used to get up from sleep by the cackle of swans, wake up now?
